heldout_target_aware_results.scientific_interpretation: negative selective MAE gain; frozen reliability policy did not improve held-out TEST MAE
heldout_target_aware_results.target_definition: standard uncapped RUL: engine terminal observed cycle - current cycle

heldout_target_aware_results.scientific_interpretation: primary held-out TEST unscored because 11 TEST engines had fewer than the frozen 30 cycles required for one terminal input window; inference stopped before scoring

interpretation.comparison_guard: Do not rank datasets by absolute MAE. C-MAPSS subsets differ in operating conditions, fault structure, target conventions, and evaluation circumstances. Absolute MAEs are reported as dataset-specific outcomes, not as a pooled performance ranking.
interpretation.cross_dataset_conclusion: Reliability-aware selective prediction showed useful error separation in FD001 and FD002 and strong DEV/corruption evidence in FD004, but it did not generalize uniformly: FD003 produced a scored held-out negative result, and FD004 exposed a structural evaluation limitation of the fixed-window protocol.
interpretation.evaluation_stage_guard: FD004 CLEAN DEV and corruption results are supporting evidence only and must not be presented as held-out TEST performance.
interpretation.fd004_supporting_findings: Before TEST access, FD004 CLEAN DEV showed positive selective MAE gain. Across 381 executable controlled-degradation scenarios, 365 showed positive selective gain; all 16 negative cases were in the stuck-sensor family, concentrated most strongly at high severity.

heldout_findings.FD001: Selective filtering improved held-out TEST MAE under both the primary capped target and the retained raw-RUL secondary analysis, at relatively low realized coverage.
heldout_findings.FD002: The frozen reliability policy improved held-out TEST MAE for the piecewise-capped RUL evaluation.
heldout_findings.FD003: The frozen reliability policy did not improve held-out TEST MAE under the uncapped/raw RUL target; accepted MAE was slightly worse than full-population MAE.
heldout_findings.FD004: No held-out TEST performance estimate is reported under the frozen protocol because short TEST trajectories made the complete endpoint population structurally inadmissible for the fixed 30-cycle input rule.

interpretation.target_guard: Capped-target rows and raw/uncapped-target rows must remain explicitly distinguished. FD002 has no recovered raw-RUL final held-out authority, and FD004 has no scored held-out TEST MAE.
